description: Class skill lists, by class (CLAUDE.md > Class Progression decides which class's level is being taken at a given character level). PHB p.59: max rank and per-rank cost are governed separately. Max rank (characterLevel + 3, half that for anything on neither list) checks whether a skill is a class skill for ANY of Lyra's classes — the union of every list below. Per-rank cost (1 vs. 2) checks only the class whose level is being taken THIS level-up — a skill can be capped at the full class-skill rank while still costing double if it isn't on the current level's own class list.

druid.source: PHB (Druid), plus Knowledge (religion) per DM ruling
